text:
tessa_sales: Incoming from MapleTrust Gov team. Requirements: CA-only for POC (inference, logs, backups, and any telemetry), BYOK with FIPS-capable customer HSM, SOC2/SOC3 evidence, and a signed commitment that no EU/APAC regions receive any control-plane telemetry. They also want a redacted subprocessor list that explicitly marks any party that could see request metadata, and a pricing delta for a 30-day gov POC vs hosted. Timeline: they want to start in 3 weeks. Can infra/sec/legal confirm feasibility and rough costs? @owen_sre @anya_security @mike_legal

owen_sre: Quick feasibility: Hosted public API is out because our control-plane uses multi-region telemetry streams that could touch non-CA endpoints. Viable options: 1) Private single-region install in ca-central-1 with customer-managed control plane (cleanest), 2) Dedicated tenant pinned to ca-central-1 with strict deny rules + disabled telemetry forwarding. If they require absolute zero control-plane egress, Private single-region is the only guaranteed path.

owen_sre: Routing/deny example (human):
```
tenant_pin: ca-central-1
allowed_regions: [ca-central-1]
deny_regions: [eu-*, ap-*, us-west-*]
control_plane_forwarding: false  # no telemetry out of region
```

anya_security: Security notes: We can provide a redacted subprocessor matrix showing which components could touch metadata (ingress LB, request router, logs pipeline, model serving nodes) and mark which are CA-local. Full detailed inventory requires NDA. For HSM: we support customer HSM (FIPS 140-2/140-3 compatible) in Private; Dedicated supports managed-HSM but requires a compliance review. We'll need a KMS attestation process (keywrap proofs, audit snapshots). Typical attestation + onboarding: 10-20 business days.

anya_security: Also: SOC2 report and SOC3 summary we can share under NDA. For gov contracts we recommend the Private install + on-prem KMS or HSM in their VPC. If they insist on Dedicated, prepare for an additional compliance window and tighter SLA negotiation.

mike_legal: Contractually, we can agree to "no EU/APAC control-plane egress" for the POC via an amendment, but we need to enumerate acceptable exceptions (emergency security alerts, legal subpoenas). Ask their counsel to clarify scope: data plane only, or control+management plane? We need customer legal contact and an NDA before sharing full subproc and SOC reports.

connectivity: Peering notes: For Private single-region we need circuit details, CIDRs, and expected throughput. Typical provisioning lead time depends on carrier: 5-15 business days. For Dedicated with private connect we'll still need BGP details and cert SANs. Important: single-region Private avoids cross-region egress charges; Dedicated with warm standby will incur egress if failover triggers.

owen_sre: Cost ballpark for 30-day gov POC (very rough): Private single-region turnkey with BYOK/FIPS HSM onboarding and compliance packaging = "$35k - $45k" for month (includes onboarding, attestation, and short-term infra). Dedicated pinned POC w/ managed-HSM + compliance review = "$18k - $26k"/mo + managed-HSM add-on "$4k/mo" + one-time compliance onboarding fee "$3k". Peering/setup one-time =~"$1.5k". I'll split precise numbers by GPU profile in the formal quote.

anya_security: I'll prepare a CA-filtered redacted subproc summary and a checklist of evidence (SOC2 summary, architecture diagram showing data paths, KMS attestation steps). Will flag any components that currently rely on multi-region control-plane services.

mike_legal: I'll draft an NDA template and a short POC amendment for the "no control-plane egress" clause with a list of example exceptions. Need their legal and security contacts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket PRESALES-CA-GOV-3032 -> presales/gov-poc-ca-byo-hsm, assigned infra+security+connectivity.

tessa_sales: Big thanks. I'll get the customer's legal/security contacts and send NDA today. Please DM the formal quote (separate channel) and a 1-page ops checklist I can include in their SOW. :thumbsup:
